outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with 'Approximately' 85 Americans remain missing in Nepal floods: State Dept. spokesperson; Police search for suspect after deadly shooting at Swiss rave; Deaths reported after ferry carrying nearly 270 passengers capsizes off Cyprus.

items.headline: 'Approximately' 85 Americans remain missing in Nepal floods: State Dept. spokesperson
items.detail: State Department Spokesperson Tommy Pigott said approximately 85 Americans remain missing in Nepal on "This Week."

items.headline: Police search for suspect after deadly shooting at Swiss rave
items.detail: A manhunt was underway early on Sunday, police in Switerland said.

items.headline: Deaths reported after ferry carrying nearly 270 passengers capsizes off Cyprus
items.detail: More than 172 people have been rescued, Northern Cyprus PM says.

items.headline: WATCH: Divers save the day for bride-to-be
items.detail: A group of divers from the Hudson Valley Commercial Diving School happened to be at the restaurant where Denise Rivera dropped her engagement ring into the Hudson River.

items.headline: WATCH: Woman alleges she was ejected from mountain coaster in Colorado
items.detail: A woman alleges she was thrown from her seat, dragged along the tracks and seriously injured as a result.
